dict.string: sentidoS records the meeting app's audio so it can transcribe the call and tell speakers apart. It stays on this Mac.
sentidoS uses the camera to track your eyes and hands. Video is processed on this Mac and never uploaded or saved as video.
sentidoS listens only while you dictate or record. Audio is transcribed on this Mac and never uploaded. Only text goes to an AI provider, if you set one up.
sentidoS turns your speech into text with Apple's on-device recognizer. Recognition runs on this Mac; your audio is not sent to Apple.
